name: PriceBoostAi Connector
author: Arki Soft

sections.description:
PriceBoostAi Connector is the official WooCommerce plugin for AI-powered price optimization and demand intelligence. Connect your WordPress store to PriceBoostAi to sync your product catalog, track competitors, forecast demand, apply pricing rules you control, get title and description suggestions for better product visibility, and optionally show optimized prices on your storefront.

Built for WooCommerce merchants who want smarter pricing and listing copy without replacing their existing catalog workflow. After you connect a store in the PriceBoostAi dashboard and paste the Store ID and API key into WordPress, the plugin can:

  • Sync WooCommerce products — publish simple, variable, and grouped products to PriceBoostAi on an hourly schedule, when you save settings, or with Synchronize now
  • Apply AI-optimized prices — optionally display PriceBoostAi recommended prices to shoppers while keeping full control in settings
  • Improve pricing models with real store data — send order totals and add-to-cart events so PriceBoostAi can refine demand and pricing insights
  • Monitor connection health — view a read-only summary of statistics, plan status, and notifications on the settings page

What you unlock in PriceBoostAi

Once your WooCommerce store is connected, use the PriceBoostAi dashboard for:

  • Competitor tracking — monitor competitor sites and product matches, accept auto-suggested URLs, or add competitors yourself to stay ahead of market prices
  • Pricing rules — set min/max prices, margin guards, schedules, and competitor response logic so AI suggestions stay inside your limits
  • Demand forecasting — forecast sales and demand signals from catalog, order, and cart data to support profit-aware pricing decisions
  • Title and description suggestions — get Search Boost recommendations to improve product titles, meta, and descriptions for stronger listing visibility
  • Product Chat — ask in plain English to set prices, schedules, and rules, then review and apply changes with approvals

Why use PriceBoostAi with WooCommerce?

  • Centralize product sync, AI pricing, competitor tracking, demand forecasting, and listing suggestions in one official connector
  • Keep standard WooCommerce prices when Auto-update price is off
  • Limit sync to selected product categories when you need focused catalogs
  • Use HTTPS API calls only after credentials are saved — no data leaves your site until you connect

This plugin is a connector to a hosted service. You need a PriceBoostAi account. Some PriceBoostAi plans are paid; billing and feature availability are handled by the service, not by locking code in this plugin. See the PriceBoostAi terms and dashboard at app.priceboostai.com.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.1 or later
  • PHP 7.4 or later
  • WooCommerce 7.8 or later

Privacy

This plugin does not send data to PriceBoostAi until a store administrator saves a Store ID and Store API key. With credentials saved, catalog, order, cart, and session identifiers described in the FAQ are transmitted to https://api.priceboostai.com over HTTPS. Store API keys are stored in the WordPress options table. Uninstalling the plugin deletes the settings option, related transients, and the hourly sync schedule.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce if it is not already active.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/priceboostai-connector, or install the zip from Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate PriceBoostAi Connector.
  4. Open Settings → PriceBoostAi.
  5. In the PriceBoostAi dashboard, connect this store and copy the Store ID and Store API key.
  6. Paste those values, choose whether optimized prices should display, optionally limit sync to product categories, and save.
  7. Click Synchronize products now, or wait for the hourly sync.
sections.faq:
Do I need a PriceBoostAi account?

Yes. The plugin does not optimize prices by itself. It talks to the PriceBoostAi API after you save a Store ID and Store API key from app.priceboostai.com.

What data is sent to PriceBoostAi?

After you save credentials, the plugin may send:

  • Product catalog data: names, descriptions, prices, image URLs, inventory, and categories
  • Order data: order ID, line items, quantities, amounts, tax, shipping, discounts, currency, and status (not customer name or email)
  • Add-to-cart events and a WooCommerce session identifier
  • A logged-in flag when requesting an optimized price during sync

No API calls are made until credentials are saved.

Does this plugin collect data from shoppers for advertising?

No. Outbound requests go only to PriceBoostAi as part of the service you connected. See PriceBoostAi’s privacy policy on priceboostai.com.

Can I keep WooCommerce prices unchanged?

Yes. Turn off Auto-update price. Customers then see the standard WooCommerce price. Product sync to PriceBoostAi still runs.

How are plugin updates delivered?

Updates come from WordPress.org after this plugin is listed in the directory. There is no third-party update server inside the plugin.
